DecisionReason: The 6 June wave is distinct from the 1 June Spiderweb attack. Reuters recorded Ukraine's strike claim. Targeted post-strike Maxar imagery reviewed by The War Zone after the 6 June attack showed little to no damage to the airfield operating area. No independent evidence of a qualifying physical target effect was found. Classify as attempted target without confirmed qualifying damage.

Ukraine reported fire in the Syzran refinery area, but the Samara governor stated that an attempted attack on an industrial enterprise in Syzran was prevented. Interfax, RIA and Rossiyskaya Gazeta reproduce the prevented-attack statement. Reuters' 1 September energy chronology still attributes independently sourced Syzran production/crude-intake suspension to the 15 August strike rather than 30 August. No independent distinct physical effect for 30 August is established.

TargetOrEvent: Engels Kombinat Kristall fuel storage facility
DecisionReason: Reuters reported Ukraine's claim that a fuel-storage facility in Engels was struck. The Saratov governor confirmed civilian-infrastructure damage in the region during the same drone wave, but this does not resolve a physical effect at Kombinat Kristall. Searches found no independent Russian/operator report, target-specific verified imagery or FIRMS/satellite evidence for the Engels node on 14 November. Earlier Engels/Kristall events cannot be inherited.

The physical fire after the drone attack remains well established by the Rostov governor, Interfax, Kommersant, Vedomosti, BFM and local Rostov reporting. A renewed target-identification search still found no source naming the facility. No reliable evidence ties the fire to the Novoshakhtinsk refinery or another unique industrial facility. TargetID, NodeID, sector and criticality remain unresolved.
